name: Realmlords
storyline:
REALMLORDS — LORE OF THE AEON‑PRISM
The First Age — The Aeon‑Prism
Before worlds, before time, before even the idea of creation, there existed a single perfect structure:

The Aeon‑Prism.

A flawless, transparent crystal realm suspended in the void, glowing with shifting rainbow light. It was not merely a place — it was the source of all elemental existence, a living harmony of:

Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Poison, Darkness, Holy, and Chromatic.

Within the Aeon‑Prism, these forces were one.
Balanced.
Unified.
Indivisible.

Until the day they weren’t.

The Fracture
A cosmic conflict erupted between Radiance and Shadow — two opposing wills that sought to claim the Prism’s power. Their clash shattered the Aeon‑Prism into eight Relics, each containing a fragment of its original perfection.

When the Prism broke, reality broke with it.

The shards fell into isolated dimensions, forming the Fractured Realms, each one shaped entirely by the Relic at its core.

The Realms sealed themselves.
The Relics slept.
But the Prism remembers.

The Rise of the Shardbearers
When the first Relic stirred, it awakened a rare kind of mortal — one whose soul resonated with the Prism’s broken light.
summary: Realmlords is a fast‑paced Bullet‑hell / Spell-hell roguelite with 12 distinct classes, each offering unique weapons, abilities, and build paths. Explore 9 dangerous Randomly Generated Elemental Realms filled with unique monsters, hazards, and loot as you fight to survive each run.
